<div class="hero-brand">

<div class="hero-summary">
  <p>Every empirical project involves data somebody had to find, collect, clean, check, and organize.
  Methods courses typically teach you techniques that assume such data is ready to go.
  This course, in contrast, equips you with practical skills and tools on how to acquire, process and verify data with Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistance.
  We cover a wide range of data types including messy tables, text, documents, images, audio, and maps.
  Work with AI will emphasize code and output verification, an emerging bottleneck in research workflows.
  In-class quizzes test mastery of basic concepts.
  Homeworks are hands-on coding mini-projects that expose students to a variety of data types and test verification skills.
  Homework assignments follow an investigation of the January 2025 Los Angeles wildfires.
  There are no prerequisites.
  </p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // The "we are here" line: mark the next class day, but only while the
  // Fall 2026 term is running — in any other year this page is an archive
  // and the script does nothing.
  var now = new Date();
  if (now < new Date(2026, 7, 20) || now > new Date(2026, 11, 10)) return;
  var months = {Jan: 0, Feb: 1, Mar: 2, Apr: 3, May: 4, Jun: 5,
                Jul: 6, Aug: 7, Sep: 8, Oct: 9, Nov: 10, Dec: 11};
  var today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.grouped-schedule tbody tr');
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (rows[i].classList.contains('part-row') ||
        rows[i].classList.contains('break-row')) continue;
    var cells = rows[i].cells;
    for (var j = 0; j < cells.length; j++) {
      var m = cells[j].textContent.trim()
        .match(/^(?:Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun) ([A-Z][a-z]{2}) (\d{1,2})$/);
      if (!m) continue;
      if (new Date(2026, months[m[1]], +m[2]) >= today) {
        rows[i].classList.add('next-class');
        cells[j].classList.add('today-cell');
        return;
      }
      break;
    }
  }
})();
</script>
